name: Boulevard Law
about: Boulevard Law is a personal injury firm with a single office in Philadelphia.
The firm states that the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Pennsylvania does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: This firm names no attorney on the pages we could read, so there is nobody to look up. The register itself exists: Pennsylvania publishes its attorney discipline as court decisions and we read them for the other firms in this market.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Pennsylvania publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 74 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 1999-04-07, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 3 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar A in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
